subject: can strip text be forced for a single row facet?

messages.author: 4e69b94a09c8cf3b
messages.subject: can strip text be forced for a single row facet?
parts:
Using a grid and viewport definitions, I am plotting a few rows of
contour plots, with each row containing three plots across. I am using
a viewport rather than doing the whole thing in a single facet_grid
because the y-facet would result in a wide sparse matrix of plots (the
y-facet is fifteen across, with each row containing but three plots and
12 empty spaces). The viewport allows me to get rid of unused real estate.

I am using facet_grid(. ~ foo) for each viewport row. However, with a
single row, the strip text seems to be dropped. Is there a way to make
the strip text show up though there is but a single row?

Thanks
